concentration.denominator_definition: percent of total mint supply; adjusted view excludes only accounts labeled lp_pool, burn, or program_escrow WITH evidence (see liquidity evidence); raw view excludes nothing

failure_policy: missing/invalid policy, unsupported token program or extension surface, RPC/indexer error, stale data, unidentified pool, or unverifiable lock/burn => FAIL or INDETERMINATE, never PASS

majors_allowlist.basis: Circle-issued major stablecoin; EXP-1 gate precedent

note: Concentration thresholds APPROVED by Kenn 2026-10-29 (balanced: max_top1_pct=10, max_top10_pct=30). Liquidity evidence methods + accepted pool programs remain null/empty (owner inputs still outstanding), so a non-major can still return INDETERMINATE on the liquidity leg; the gate never PASSes on missing data. Majors pass by identity (allowlist).
